name: XDKNet 2.5.2
body:
Android TV 2.5.2, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.2 (Emby 2.0.5.2).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## Leaving the player in the Jellyfin iOS app

In the web app inside the Jellyfin iOS app, the back button did nothing once
a movie or episode had started, so there was no way out of the player. It now
closes the player straight away. Live TV had the same problem and is fixed
too.

Leaving the player also no longer waits on the device for more than a couple
of seconds, on any platform, so a TV, phone or browser that is slow to put
the screen back can't keep you in the player.

The web app gets the fix with plugin 2.1.0.2 (Emby 2.0.5.2), which carries
the updated web client.

Pair with plugin 2.1.0.2 (Emby 2.0.5.2).
